crossRefs.note: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

translations.web: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
translations.bsb: “Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
translations.kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
translations.asv: Hear my words, ye wise men; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
